review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only bundle. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 consistently specify notification-time eligibility, completion ordering, control-symbol exclusion, hook error handling and default-pMap-only exposure. The exact writable scope contains the runtime owner, maintained declaration owner and both regression files; package.json establishes xo, AVA and tsd as the existing verification sequence without requiring configuration edits. Shared runtime forwarding and shared declaration types are visible within those owners. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification, including implementation and verification coverage of every required AC. The allowed agents have matching roles, availability and supplied project-scoped active capability records, including data.change, domain.state and integration.consumer; eligibility does not rely on Persona or pending claims. The configured verifier can satisfy the supplied planning-review policy, subject to independence from planning authors. No unresolved material DEC-001 or B/C variant is present in this case, so the empty decision input and ready expectation are consistent. Historical project reuse does not itself invalidate this bundle's candidate isolation or preserved claim scope. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct PRD, manifest, evaluation-source and executing-module digest domains. Preparation-time remaining/runnable fields are not candidate readiness results. Truncated existing test excerpts and unavailable dependency internals do not undermine the bounded planning expectation, but do not establish successful execution. This review used only the supplied data, created no human attestation, executed no code and did not independently recompute digests.
